# Kay v2 Reference (for humans & coding agents)

> Kay v2 is a Bun-native TSX web framework with zero-directive automatic islands, `.value` fine-grained signals, flat-string SSR, unified Standard-Schema actions, single-binary `--compile`, and a composable `KayPlugin` API.

## Core Rules (everything fits on one page)

- **Imports**: `@kayjs/kay` (signals, `Head`, `Suspense`, contexts, `useAction`), `@kayjs/kay/server` (actions, `raw`, `esc`, route types, security helpers, `createServer({ root })` to run a built app inside another program), `@kayjs/kay/config` (`defineConfig`, `definePlugin`, plugin types), `@kayjs/kay/test`. A bare `kay` import fails the compile (`kay upgrade` rewrites them); `@kayjs/kay/internal/*` is compiler output, outside semver.
- **Standard TSX & compiler guardrails**: `.tsx` files with `jsxImportSource: "@kayjs/kay"`. Use `class` or `className` (never both). Standard `.map()` (with `key={...}`), `&&`, ternaries, `{...spread}`, SVG elements, style strings or objects (`style={{ color: 'red' }}`), and CSS / `*.module.css` imports work natively. Compiler/runtime refuse common React/Solid/Astro habits: `innerHTML={html}` takes a string or `raw(html)` (never `{ __html }`, never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, never on void elements or with children); events are camelCase DOM names (`onClick`, `onDblClick`, `onKeyDown` — never lowercase `onclick`, `on:click`, `onDoubleClick`, `*Capture`, string handlers, or render-time assignments); `ref` is always a callback `ref={el => ...}` (never `{ current }`); SVG attrs use kebab-case (`stroke-width`, `fill-opacity`); use `value`/`checked` (not `defaultValue`/`defaultChecked`) and boolean `{false}` (not `"false"`); no `client:*`/`use:*`/`class:list`/`set:html` directives; no Promises, functions, signals, or plain objects in JSX text/attrs. Spreads drop `on*`, `innerHTML`, `srcdoc`, and `javascript:`/`vbscript:` URLs.
- **Signals (`@kayjs/kay`)**: `const count = signal(0)` (`.value` read/write, `.peek()` untracked), `computed(() => ...)`, `effect(() => ...)` (return cleanup; skipped while an island renders on the server, so derive values with `computed`), `batch(() => ...)`, `untrack(() => ...)`, `root(dispose => ...)`, `onMount(() => ...)` (runs after DOM attach; return cleanup), `onCleanup(() => ...)`, `getOwner()`, `selector(() => id.value)` (O(1) selection), `store(obj)` + `snapshot(s)`. To let a child mutate parent state, pass the signal directly (`<Modal open={isOpen} />`).
- **Reactive props**: Destructuring props (`function Badge({ count = 0, ...rest }: Props)`) stays reactive in client components; server-rendered children inside islands are preserved via `<kay-slot>`.
- **Automatic islands**: Any component using reactive primitives (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `onMount`, `store`, `selector`), DOM `on*` handlers/`ref`, or imported reactive module state becomes an island automatically, decided per component: a static export beside an island stays static, a same-file helper or component that needs the browser makes each component calling or rendering it an island, and a primitive called at a file's top level makes every component of it one. Control hydration per call site with `$hydrate="load" | "visible" | "idle" | "interaction" | "media(...)" | "client"`, or the component file's default `export const hydrate = 'visible'` (unknown modes and `$hydrate` on non-islands fail compile). `<Head>`/`<Suspense>` in an island fail compile; an island reading a context provided outside it throws in SSR (pass the value as a prop); server children handed to an island render before it, in the page's scope. Hydration steps over a node an extension injected and redraws a part whose tag differs from the server's, in production too (dev also warns). Island props crossing the server boundary must be serializable (JSON primitives + `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, `URL`, `RegExp` — functions and signals are refused). Islands cannot import server-only modules (`bun:sqlite`, `node:*`, `@kayjs/kay/server`) or read `process.env` other than `process.env.PUBLIC_*` (inlined at build time); action files are stubbed on the client (non-action exports from them cannot be imported by islands).
- **Routes (`src/routes/`)**:
  - `export default async function Page({ params, locals, url })`: strictly server-only (`0 KB` JS; cannot use signals/handlers directly).
  - Sync `export default function Page({ data, params, locals, url })`: static or auto-island; optional `export async function load(ctx)` runs server-only and returns data or a `Response` (e.g. `404` / redirect).
  - Special files: `_layout.tsx` (nested outer→inner, receives `{ children, params, locals, url }`, server-only), `_middleware.ts` (`(ctx, next) => Response`, outer→inner), `_error.tsx` (receives `{ error }`, server-only, wrapped in root layout), `_404.tsx` (server-only, wrapped in root layout, also emitted as `404.html` in `--static`); each needs a default export. Any other file under `src/routes/` must export a page, a method handler or an action (guarded by its folder's `_middleware.ts`), else `kay build`/`kay check` fail: prefix helpers or their folder with `_`.
  - Params: `[slug].tsx` → `params.slug`; `[...path].tsx` → `params.path`.
  - API routes: `.ts` files exporting `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` receiving `RequestContext` (`request`, `url`, `params`, `cookies`, `locals`, `ip`, `json()`, `text()`, `redirect()`, `deny()`). Optional `export const csrf = false` opts out of origin checks (e.g. webhooks/bearer APIs).
  - Prerendering: `export const prerender = true` (+ `export function paths() { return ['/posts/a'] }` required for dynamic routes; unlisted params return `404`). Skipped in `kay dev`.
- **Streaming & Head**: `<Head><title>...</title></Head>` (innermost `<title>` wins); `<Suspense fallback={<p>Loading</p>} error={<p>Failed</p>}><AsyncComp /></Suspense>` streams resolved HTML inline with 0 KB external JS (takes exactly one child; nested boundaries supported; times out after `streamTimeout`, default `30000` ms; errors also fire `onError`).
- **Actions (`@kayjs/kay/server`)**: `export const fn = action(standardSchema, async (input, ctx) => ..., options?)` or `action(async (ctx) => ...)` — must be a top-level named export so Kay can assign a URL. Works as zero-JS `<form action={fn} method="post">` (array fields auto-coerced from checkboxes/multi-selects; validation failures set an `HttpOnly` flash cookie readable via `getActionError(ctx.locals)` with sensitive fields stripped or `flashFields` allowlisted and `303` redirect to trusted Referer) and as typed island RPC `const res = await fn(data)` (always resolves to `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, status, error, fieldErrors?, issues? }`; accepts `FormData` for files; redirects navigate the page). A route, `load()`, middleware or another action may also call it: it runs in that request, schema and folder `_middleware.ts` included, and resolves to the same result; called outside a request it throws. Server code is stripped from client bundles; CSRF `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` is checked before middleware and body parsing; folder `_middleware.ts` runs before the handler. `ctx` provides `redirect()` and `deny(status, message, fieldErrors?)`.
- **Config & Security (`kay.config.ts`, `@kayjs/kay/config`)**: `defineConfig({ lang, port, routesDir, outDir, publicDir, assetPrefix, security, trustedOrigins, trustProxy, maxRequestBodySize, streamTimeout, compress, onError, plugins })`. Default security headers (`security: false` to disable, or override `csp`, `hsts`, `frameOptions`, `referrerPolicy`, `contentTypeOptions`) attach strict `DEFAULT_CSP` (style attributes allowed) with automatic SHA-256 hashes for island/Suspense styles, the app's own `<style>` blocks and stream scripts, plus `HSTS` on HTTPS requests. `trustProxy: true | number` trusts that many right-most proxy hops for `X-Forwarded-*`. `maxRequestBodySize` defaults to `1 MiB`. `defineEnv(standardSchema)` validates env vars at startup; `nodeEnv()` reads `NODE_ENV` at runtime (safe in `--compile`).
- **Static files & CSS**: Files in `public/` are served at `/` with ETag/`304` (and `Cache-Control: no-cache` in `kay dev`; embedded in `--static` and `--compile`). Import `.css` or `*.module.css` directly from any component or layout.
- **CLI**: `kay new <dir> [--template minimal|fullstack|blog|app] [--force]` (its `AGENTS.md` points agents at this file, installed at `node_modules/@kayjs/kay/llms.txt`), `kay check [dir] [--no-typecheck]`, `kay dev [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]` (loopback `127.0.0.1` default; a `kay.config.ts` that fails to load stops it naming `kay.config.ts:<line>:<col>: <error>`), `kay build [dir] [--static] [--compile [out]] [--analyze] [--max-js <size>]` (`--analyze` lists each route's eager JS and its islands with why each is one; `--max-js 40kb` fails on a route whose gzipped eager JS is over it, naming its eager islands), `kay start [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]`, `kay upgrade [dir] [--no-install]` (moves an app from bare `kay` imports to `@kayjs/kay` and `icons` to `@kayjs/icons/plugin`, and registers stateful plugins as their handles), plus plugin commands (`kay ui-eject <grammar> [dest]`, `kay mcp-footprint`, `kay i18n-check`, `kay icons-find <words> [--set <prefix>] [--limit <n>]`). `kay --help`, `kay <command> --help` and `kay --completions fish|bash|zsh` come from `@kaynooo/cli-kit`; a typo'd command or option names the one meant. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 a finding or failure (`kay check` found an error, `kay upgrade` has steps left by hand, a build failed), 2 a usage error (unknown command or option, bad port or `--max-js`). Plugin commands are read from `kay.config.ts` only when the first word is no built-in, and take `--root <dir>` and `--help`; a config that fails to load leaves `kay --help` and the built-ins working, and a plugin command typed then names the error (exit 1).
- **Testing (`@kayjs/kay/test`)**: `const app = await testApp({ root, prebuilt? })` — in-process `app.get()`, `app.post()`, `app.import(path)` (the app's bundled copy of a route, action file or `kay.config.ts`), `app.submit(action | url, fields)`, `app.fetch()`, `app.cookies`, `app.clearCookies()` with persistent cookie jar and zero port binding; `app.errors` lists unhandled route/action/plugin errors (`route GET /p: message`), and `testApp({ dev: true })` shows them in the 500 like `kay dev` does. Unhandled errors with `dev` (kay dev, `dev: true`): `console.error` unless an `onError` hook exists, and the 500 carries message and stack (JSON `{ ok: false, status: 500, error, stack }` when the request wants JSON, else text; `_error.tsx` still renders); production stays `Internal Server Error`. `kay dev` build errors also answer JSON/text per `Accept`. Islands: `const b = await testBrowser({ root, timeout?, browserPath? })` (needs `playwright-core` as a dev dependency and Chrome/Chromium; production build served on `b.origin`, a free 127.0.0.1 port) then `const page = await b.open(path)` (resolves once the page has loaded and its `load`/`client` islands have hydrated; `visible`, `idle` and `interaction` ones are the test's to trigger) with `page.click(sel)`, `page.fill(sel, value)`, `page.text(sel)`, `page.waitFor(sel | fn)`, `page.evaluate(fn)`, `page.errors` (page errors, console errors, 4xx/5xx responses), `page.close()`, and `await b.close()` at the end.
- **Plugins (`kay.config.ts`)**: `export default defineConfig({ plugins: [...] })` / `definePlugin(...)`.
  - A stateful plugin's `createX()` returns the plugin and the app's handle in one object: `plugins: [auth, mail, rooms]`, with `auth.guard()`, `mail.send()`, `rooms.publish()` in routes. Stateless plugins are `x()`.
  - Hooks: `server(api)` (`use`, `route(method, path, handler, { csrf?, trustedOrigins?, trustProxy? })` (responses get the security headers; an HTML one without its own CSP gets the app's, its `<style>` blocks hashed), `rewrite`, `provide(key, value)`/`inject(key)` typed by `serviceKey<T>(name)` from `@kayjs/kay/config`, `getBuildData`), `onError(info)`, `build(ctx)` (`emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `addStyle`, `addRouteStyle`, `addHead`, `addRouteHead`, `provide`, `inject`, `setData`, `routes`), `afterPrerender(ctx)` (`routes`, `publicFiles`, `emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `setData`), `transform`, `bunPlugins` (array or `({ root, assetPrefix, minify, target }) => [...]`), `css`, `head(head, ctx)`, `transformHtml`, `prerenderPaths`, `clientEntry`, `check(ctx)`, `watchPaths`, `commands`.
  - Runtime state (timers, connections, caches) is created in `server(api)` and released in `api.onShutdown()`, never in the plugin factory (a throwing `onShutdown` or `onError` hook is logged with its plugin's name; the others still run): `kay dev` starts the next server on the same instance before shutting the last one down.
  - First-party packages (13 total with `@kayjs/kay`):
    - `@kayjs/ui`: Platform-first headless primitives (`Stack`, `Cluster`, `Grid`, `Sidebar`, `Split`, `Button`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Notice`, `Field`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Accordion`, `Popover`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Menu`, `Select`, `CommandPalette`, `DataTable`, `Toaster` + `toast()`) & pure CSS `@layer kui` Style Grammars (`orbit`, `editorial`, `workshop`, `console`, `soft`, `bare`); `kay ui-eject <grammar> [dest]`.
    - `@kayjs/auth`: Argon2id passwords, hashed DB sessions, email verification (`requireEmailVerification: true` default), magic links (first claim drops prior password/sessions/OAuth links), OAuth 2.0 + PKCE (`github()`, `discord()`, `google()`, `oauthProvider()`), `auth.guard()`, `site` required off localhost, IP+email rate limiting (`trustProxy`), RGPD helpers (`listSessions`, `exportUser`, `deleteUser`, `pruneExpired`, `storeIp`, `storeUserAgent`), `memoryAuthStore()` & `sqliteAuthStore()` (`bun:sqlite`).
    - `@kayjs/content`: Zero-dep `Bun.markdown` + `Bun.YAML` nested frontmatter + Standard Schema, lazy memoized Markdown rendering (`await entry.render()`) + O(1) `get(slug)`, `highlight(code, lang)` hook (Shiki-ready), MDX-lite embedded TSX `components`, `headingLinks`, auto-wired `@kayjs/images` optimization (`resolveImage: false` to opt out), localized collections (`localized: true`), TOC, and RSS feeds (`content({ feeds })`).
    - `@kayjs/live`: Typed SSE rooms (`createRooms<TMessage, TMember>({ path, room, member, onJoin, onLeave, authorize })` mounts the stream at `path`; without `path`, a route calls `rooms.stream(ctx, ...)`), `publish(room, message, event?)`, microtask-coalesced broadcasts (`rooms.coalesce(build)`), `useLive(url, onMessage)` browser signal hook.
    - `@kayjs/mcp`: Opt-in MCP Streamable HTTP (`2025-03-26`) plugin exposing typed `action()` handlers & compacted Standard JSON Schema tools (strips coercion branches, `x-*`, no-op bounds, folds homogeneous records) at `/mcp/tools` with bearer auth (`404` unconfigured, `401` invalid), `schemas`+`schemaRef` (`describe_schema`), `resources`, `format`/`formatResult`, `pruneEmpty`, `maxOutputChars`, `annotations`, `formatLines`/`formatTable`, `budget` warnings in dev/`kay check`, and `kay mcp-footprint` / `inspectMcpFootprint()`.
    - `@kayjs/images`: Build-time AVIF/WebP pipeline + disk cache (`images()`, `image()`, `<Picture>`, `optimizeImageFile()`) + 1200×630 OG PNG `shareCard()`.
    - `@kayjs/seo`: `titleTemplate`, localized `description`, multi-favicon, OG/Twitter/JSON-LD, `sitemap.xml` (`extraUrls`), redirects, self-hosted fonts (`@fontsource/*`).
    - `@kayjs/i18n`: Locale URL rewriting (`ctx.locals.locale`/`t`/`localize`/`alternates`), `<html lang>` + internal link prefixing (`data-no-localize` opt-out), `prerenderPaths` expansion, `hreflang` alternates, `localizePath()`, `alternateLinks()`, `formatDate()`, `formatNumber()`, automatic `kay check` + `kay i18n-check`.
    - `@kayjs/icons`: Virtual `~icons/<set>/<name>` inline SVG imports + `<Icon>` (islands too; takes SVG attributes, labelled by `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` else `aria-hidden`); register `icons()` from `@kayjs/icons/plugin`, which also types `~icons/*` imports (a tsconfig leaving out `kay.config.ts` adds `/// <reference types="@kayjs/icons/ambient" />`). `.svg` files in `src/icons` are the set `local` (`~icons/local/logo`, each with a `viewBox` or `width`/`height`); `icons({ dirs: { brand: 'assets/brand' } })` adds folders, and naming `src/icons` there renames `local`. `kay icons-find <words>` prints the `~icons/...` specifiers matching the words, up to 10 per set (`--limit`), from the installed `@iconify-json/*` or `@iconify/json` sets, hoisted ones included, the `.svg` folders and `icons({ sets })` (`--set` picks one); run it before importing an icon rather than guessing its name. `kay check` and the build fail on an icon or set that does not exist, naming the file and the closest icons. It also matches a related word (`garbage` finds `trash`), a typo (`calnedar`), another form of a word (`searching`), a half-typed word (`shopp`) and two words typed apart (`sign out` finds `logout`); English only. `findIcons(set, query, { limit, offset })` from `@kayjs/icons/search` does the same for an app's own picker: names holding the query as whole words first (any word order), then related ones, those answering more query words first, then mid-word hits (`pin` in `spinner`) (throws on a negative or fractional `offset`/`limit`); `relatedWords(word)` gives `[word, strength]` pairs for an "also searched" list; it reads a ~1.7 MB word table on first call, so keep it server-side (an island importing it gets a build warning).
    - `@kayjs/mail`: `createMailer({ from, transport, previewRoute, preview })`, `resend()` HTTP transport (auto-uses `RESEND_API_KEY`), custom transports; registered, it mounts the dev-only `/_kay/mail` (+ `.json`) outbox preview (never in production).
    - `@kayjs/tailwind`: Tailwind v4 via `tailwind()` (auto-loads `bun-plugin-tailwind`, defaults `css: 'src/app.css'`).
    - `@kayjs/spa`: Opt-in SPA navigation (`spa()`) with `[data-persist]` islands, `data-no-spa` opt-out, `[data-kay-prefetch]` hover prefetch, head/style diffing, and focus/live-region announcements.
- **Server builds & `--compile`**: Server `Bun.build` keeps npm dependencies external (`packages: 'external'`) while compiling `@kayjs/*` TSX packages; `kay build --compile` bundles everything + `public/` assets (`with { type: "file" }`) into one standalone Bun executable (`NODE_ENV` defaults to `production`). `kay start` and compiled binaries stop gracefully on `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT`/`SIGHUP`: no new connections, `api.onShutdown()` hooks run (`@kayjs/live` ends its streams), exit 0 once in-flight requests answer, exit 1 after 10 s.
